senses.gloss: अ॑प्य (2, 3) mf(अ॑प्या; once अ॑पी, RV. vi, 67, 9) n being in water, coming from water, connected with water, RV. (cf. 3. आ॑प्य).
अ॑प्य See 2. अ॑प्.
1. आ॑प्य mfn. to be reached, obtainable, ŚBr.
(also) friendly, kind, RV. iii, 2, 6.
आ॑प्य n. confederation, alliance, relationship, friendship, RV. ii, 29, 3, &c.
a friend, RV. vii, 15, 1
(for 2. आप्य See p. 144, col. 1.)
2. आप्य mfn. (fr. 2. अप्), belonging or relating to water, watery, liquid, Suśr.
consisting of water
living in water
आप्य m. N. of several asterisms, VarBṛ.
N. of a Vasu
आप्य m. pl. N. of a class of deities, BhP.; Hariv.
आप्य n. N. of a constellation
(for 1. आप्य See under √ आप्.)
3. आप्य n. N. of a plant, a kind of Costus, L. (cf. वाप्य.)
अप्य्-अय m. joint, juncture, Kauś.; Śulb.
pouring out (of a river), PBr.; entering into, vanishing (the contrary of प्रभव or उत्पत्ति), Up. &c. (cf. स्वाप्यय॑.)
अप्य्-अय See 2. अपी.
आ-प्याय m. becoming full, increasing, Kathās.
आ-प्याय्य mfn. to be satisfied or pleased, MBh.
अप्य्-अय—दीक्षित m. N. of a Drāviḍa saint and writer (of the sixteenth century, author of various works, celebrated as a Śaiva, and thought to be an incarnation of Śiva; also अप्याय˚ or अप्यै˚, &c.)
अप्य्-अयन n. union, copulating, L.
आ-प्या॑यन mfn. causing fulness or stoutness, Suśr.
increasing welfare, gladdening, L.
आ-प्या॑यन (अम्), n. the act of making full or fat, Suśr.
satiating
satisfying, refreshing, pleasing, Mn.
increasing, causing to thrive, MBh.
causing to swell (the Soma), ŚBr. &c.
satiety, satisfaction
advancing
anything which causes corpulency or good condition
strengthening medicine, Suśr.
corpulency, growing or being fat or stout
gladness, L.
अप्पदीक्षित or अप्यदीक्षित m. N. of an author = अप्यय-दीक्षित, q.v.
अप्य्-अत्य्-√ अर्ज् (3. pl. -अर्जन्ति) to add over and above, AitBr.

अप्य्-√ अद् to eat off, ŚBr. xiv :
Caus. -आदयति, to give more (food) to eat, AitBr.
अ॑प्य्-अर्धम् ind. within proximity, near to (gen.), ŚBr. (cf. अभ्य्-अर्ध॑स्.)
अप्य्-√ 2. अस् (Subj. Ā. 2. sg. -अस्या-थाः) to insert, AitBr.
अप्य्-आ-√ हृ (Pot. अ॑प्य् आ॑ हरेत्) to take or assume in addition, TS.
अप्य्-उत = अपि + उत, q.v.
आप्येय m. pl. (fr. 1. अप् ?), N. of a class of deities (= आपेय), KapS.
आप्येय—त्व n. = आपेय-त्व, ib.
आ-प्यान mfn. stout, robust, increased
glad, T.
आ-प्यान n. increasing
stoutness
gladness, T.
आ-प्या॑न—वत् = आ-पीन-वत्, ŚBr. vii, 3, 1, 12, &c.
आ-प्या॑यनी f. an umbilical vein, MārkP.
आ-प्यायन—वत् mfn. causing or effecting welfare, increase, MaitrUp.
आ-प्यायन—शील mfn. capable of satisfying.
आ-प्यायित mfn. satisfied, increased, improved, pleased, gratified
stout, fat
grown, spread out (as a disease).
आ-प्यायिन् mfn. causing welfare or increase, Kathās.
आ-प्यायिनी f. N. of a Śakti, L.
